name: Fay
source:
Fay offers calm insight and support, balancing intellect with a quiet care for others.

He overextends himself for others while avoiding his own emotional needs.

Raised in a strict, self-denying household, Fay turned to astronomy as a personal refuge, seeking meaning beyond imposed expectations.
